notes: Task 10 (GraphRAGTools, Phase B7). Ports 9 Node.js GraphRAGTools to Python. First phase to exercise GraphGuidedRetrieval.get_code_context (B3) + SessionManager state tools (B3) together from the tool layer. No deployments, no ECR pushes, no AgentCore Runtime updates, no mcp_server_node/ changes.

completedSteps.name: Task 10.1 - Implement src/tools/graph_rag.py (9 tools)
completedSteps.notes: 1308 lines. register(mcp, data, *, session_manager=None). Default SessionManager constructed against standard state_dir when not injected. 5 graph/vector-backed tools (get_code_context, search_architecture, find_similar_code, get_change_impact, trace_data_flow) require data; 4 session tools (mark_as_modified, get_session_context, checkpoint_state, restore_checkpoint) work in degraded mode via injected SessionManager. Schemas match Node.js GraphRAGTools.js exactly. CHANGE_TYPE_RISK_BIAS and _compute_risk_score are byte-identical ports of the Node.js _computeRiskScore formula. get_code_context uses GraphGuidedRetrieval.get_code_context (B3) for GGSR + semantic fusion; tool layer renders markdown (engine returns structured GGSRRetrievalResult). include_community adds a Subsystem Context block from the community-summaries vector collection. Change-type enum divergence: get_change_impact uses {signature, behavior, delete, rename}; mark_as_modified uses {content, signature, delete, rename} — only 'behavior' vs 'content' differs. Pytest after 10.1: 306 passed, 66 skipped, 0 failed.

completedSteps.name: Task 10.3 - Unit tests in tests/unit/test_graph_rag_tools.py (74 tests)
completedSteps.notes: 1374 lines, 74 tests. Schema parity (names/required/defaults/enums); degraded-mode split (parametrized across 5 graph-backed + 3 session tools); empty-argument validation; per-tool happy-path rendering; get_code_context fuzzy-match fallback, include_community routing, token_budget=0 suppresses GGSR, examined-symbol side effect, depth clamp; search_architecture community rendering + max_results clamp; find_similar_code threshold filtering, similarity clamp to [0,1], 2x over-fetch, max_results clamp to 25; get_change_impact dependent tables, include_indirect flag, change_type routing (parametrized over all 4 values), indirect-query skip when direct>=100, _compute_risk_score math parity; trace_data_flow outgoing, shortestPath, max_depth clamp to 10; session lifecycle round-trip (mark -> checkpoint -> more mods -> restore); invalid checkpoint ID returns [ERROR]; graph-error propagation for all 5 data-backed tools; default SessionManager. Two iterations: (1) depth=2 triggers GGSR 2-hop cypher distinct from 1-hop — fixed by forcing depth=1 in the test; (2) community suppression test over-asserted on text that legitimately appears in Semantic Snippets — narrowed to the ## Subsystem Context heading only. Full suite: 380 passed, 66 skipped, 0 failed.

completedSteps.name: Task 10.2 - Parity tests in tests/parity/test_graph_rag_parity.py (45 live cases)
completedSteps.notes: 1069 lines, 53 test nodes (8 hermetic + 45 live). Hermetic: catalogue coverage (>=5 per tool, >=45 total), schema parity against Node.js source, framework PASS/FAIL sanity, symbol-extractor dedupe, affected-symbols section scoping, similarity-score TOLERANCE, session structural check. 45 live cases gated on RUN_PARITY=1: get_code_context/get_change_impact/trace_data_flow/find_similar_code use SET_EQUALITY on _extract_symbol_names (backtick-wrapped tokens); search_architecture uses SET_EQUALITY on community titles + TOLERANCE on relevance scores; find_similar_code adds TOLERANCE on the similarity column. Session-mutating tools (mark_as_modified, get_session_context, checkpoint_state, restore_checkpoint) use EXACT on a structural boolean [has_block] — both runtimes may diverge on session state but must render the same block shape. restore_checkpoint accepts either '# Checkpoint Restored' or '[ERROR]' as valid shapes. AgentCoreToolCaller imported from test_semantic_search_parity via direct import (no duplication). One trivial bug: used seen.add() on a list — fixed to seen.append + separate set. Full suite: 388 passed, 111 skipped (30 B6 + 36 B5 + 45 B7), 0 failed.

find_similar_code with include_source=true is accepted by the Node.js schema but the behaviour is not documented in the Node.js code; the Python port matches the Node.js rendering (no inline source block). Defer to a later polish pass if product feedback wants inline snippets.

get_session_context(include_dirty=false) currently only affects the markdown footer line since the Python port has no in-memory dirty-state view to suppress. If a future phase adds one, update the tool to filter modifications accordingly.
